name: robots/mingfeisun__deepmimic_mujoco
title: DeepMimic humanoid MuJoCo environment (reduced fake)
intro: DeepMimic humanoid MuJoCo environment (reduced fake), adapted from mingfeisun/deepmimic_mujoco. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
